english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a human or animal body, including the fleshly body contrasted with the soul and the torso in contexts such as boxing.

exampleSentences.english: Exercise can make the body healthier.
exampleSentences.traditional: 做運動可以令身體更加健康。
exampleSentences.jyutping: zou6 wan6 dung6 ho2 ji5 ling6 san1 tai2 gang3 gaa1 gin6 hong1

english.note: Use 身體 when “flesh” means the human body as a whole rather than its tissue or meat.

exampleSentences.english: This disease slowly eats away at the flesh.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢種病會慢慢侵蝕人嘅身體。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ne1 zung2 beng6 wui5 maan6 maan2 cam1 sik6 jan4 ge3 san1 tai2
